title: Ten-Item Personality Inventory
description: 10 trait pairs rated 1–7 on agreement; two items per Big Five domain.

holder.name: Samuel D. Gosling (University of Texas at Austin)

citation.text: Gosling SD, Rentfrow PJ, Swann WB Jr (2003). A very brief measure of the Big-Five personality domains. Journal of Research in Personality 37(6):504–528.

scoring.text: Reverse items 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10, then average each pair: extraversion = 1, 6; agreeableness = 2, 7; conscientiousness = 3, 8; emotional stability = 4, 9; openness = 5, 10. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.
